column2: There is a lion in the forest, and there are many trees there.
column3: 森林里有一头狮子，那儿有很多树。

column2: The lion is strong, but the mouse is weak and thin.
column3: 狮子很强壮，可老鼠却又弱又瘦。

column2: One day they become good friends.
column3: 有一天，他们成了好朋友。

column2: He catches them in a net.
column3: 他用网把他们罩住了。

column2: Please help me! Go away, bad cat!
column3: 求求你救救我！走开，坏猫！

column2: How can I get out of this hole?
column3: 我怎么才能从这个洞里出去？

column2: The lion is angry and sad.
column3: 狮子又生气又难过。

column2: My back hurts.
column3: 我的背很疼。

column2: He is kind to me, and we have a good friendship.
column3: 他对我很友好，我们的友谊很深。

column2: Let’s have a party, and I like your idea.
column3: 我们开个聚会吧，我喜欢你的主意。

column2: The mouse comes from the forest.
column3: 这只老鼠来自森林。

column2: Let me show you around our school.
column3: 我带你参观一下我们的学校。

column2: This is our playground, and that is the swing.
column3: 这是我们的操场，那是秋千。

column2: My classroom is on the first floor.
column3: 我的教室在一楼。

column2: The computer room is on the second floor.
column3: 电脑教室在二楼。

column2: The piano is in the music room on the third floor.
column3: 钢琴在三楼的音乐教室里。

column2: Have a look at the other room.
column3: 去看看另一个房间吧。

column2: Be careful, and I feel happy here.
column3: 小心点，我在这儿感觉很开心。

column2: Please take your bag, and we will go later.
column3: 请带上你的包，我们待会儿就走。

column2: Do you have any questions?
column3: 你有什么问题吗？

column2: We must learn about road safety.
column3: 我们必须学习道路安全知识。

column2: Take the bus and get off at the next stop.
column3: 坐公共汽车，在下一站下车。

column2: Wait for the traffic light, and cross the road when it is safe.
column3: 等红绿灯，安全的时候再过马路。

column2: The road is busy, so stay close to me.
column3: 路上人来车往，所以跟紧我。

column2: Look left and right before you cross.
column3: 过马路前看看左边和右边。

column2: What’s the matter? You look tired.
column3: 怎么了？你看起来很累。

column2: I am hungry and thirsty, and I want some water.
column3: 我又饿又渴，想喝点水。

column2: He is ill, so he goes home.
column3: 他生病了，所以回家了。

column2: Have a rest, dear. It is hot.
column3: 亲爱的，休息一下吧。天很闷热。

column2: Set the table, and put the bread on it.
column3: 摆好餐具，把面包放上去。

column2: My bag is heavy, and you care about me.
column3: 我的包很重，你很关心我。

column2: Let’s eat out today.
column3: 我们今天出去吃饭吧。

column2: What would you like? Here is the menu.
column3: 你想要什么？这是菜单。

column2: I would like fried rice, a spring roll and a bowl of noodles.
column3: 我要炒饭、一份春卷和一碗面条。

column2: A cup of tea and a glass of juice, please.
column3: 请来一杯茶和一杯果汁。

column2: Fish and chips and a sandwich are my favourite food.
column3: 炸鱼薯条和三明治是我最喜欢的食物。

column2: The hot dog is delicious. Anything else?
column3: 热狗很好吃。还要别的吗？

column2: Next time let’s have hot pot.
column3: 下次我们吃火锅吧。

column2: Put it in a takeaway box.
column3: 把它装进打包盒里。

column2: My parents have good jobs.
column3: 我父母都有好工作。

column2: My father is a driver, and my mother is a nurse.
column3: 我爸爸是司机，我妈妈是护士。

column2: The doctor and the nurse work in a hospital.
column3: 医生和护士在医院工作。

column2: A teacher, a worker and a farmer are all busy people.
column3: 教师、工人和农民都是忙碌的人。

column2: A cook works in a restaurant.
column3: 厨师在饭馆工作。

column2: A police officer helps sick people.
column3: 警察帮助生病的人。

column2: I go to work by taxi or by train.
column3: 我坐出租车或火车去上班。

column2: This is a good place, and I know the way.
column3: 这是个好地方，我认得路。

column2: What a big house!
column3: 多大的一所房子啊！

column2: On the weekend I do chores at home.
column3: 周末我在家做家务。

column2: I wash the dishes and water the flowers.
column3: 我洗碗，还浇花。

column2: I make the bed, and that is part of my work.
column3: 我铺床，这是我分内的事。

column2: Good job! You finished half of it.
column3: 干得漂亮！你做完一半了。

column2: It is half past seven, so we must go.
column3: 七点半了，所以我们得走了。

column2: Mum is in the kitchen. I can’t wait!
column3: 妈妈在厨房里。我等不及了！

column2: Get some milk, a tomato and a potato.
column3: 去拿些牛奶、一个西红柿和一个土豆。

column2: Cut the meat and the chicken.
column3: 把肉和鸡肉切开。

column2: Put an egg in the soup, and give it to him.
column3: 往汤里打一个鸡蛋，然后端给他。

column2: It is your birthday, and the cake is really good.
column3: 今天是你的生日，蛋糕真的很好吃。
